User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the DesignDock application, storing their profile information and serving as a link to an external authentication system like Firebase.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity. This ID typically corresponds to the user's ID from an external authentication system (e.g., Firebase Auth UID).

role.description: The role of the user within the application, determining their permissions.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a high-level project or category that groups multiple designs.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this project.

startDate.description: The start date of the project.

endDate.description: The end date of the project.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the project was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated.

Design.title: Design
Design.description: Represents a design created and managed by a user in the DesignDock application, including details, links, and associated images.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Design entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this design. (Relationship: User 1:N Design)

projectId.description: Reference to the Project this design belongs to. (Relationship: Project 1:N Design)

projectName.description: Denormalized name of the project for easier display.

version.description: The version of the design, e.g., '1.0'.

description.description: A detailed description of the design.

figmaLink.description: URL to the Figma design file for this design.

prototypeUrl.description: URL to the live prototype of the design.

imageUrl.description: URL to the associated image for the design.

tags.description: A list of keywords or tags associated with the design.

isPublic.description: Indicates if the design is publicly accessible.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the design was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the design was last updated.

Invite.title: Invite
Invite.description: Represents an invitation for a new user to join the application.

email.description: The email of the user being invited.

role.description: The role assigned to the user upon signup.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invite was created.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Represents an entry in the audit log, recording a significant action taken by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry.

userId.description: The UID of the user who performed the action.

userDisplayName.description: The display name of the user at the time of the action.

userEmail.description: The email of the user at the time of the action.

entityType.description: The type of entity that was affected.

entityId.description: The ID of the entity that was affected.

entityName.description: The name or identifier of the entity for display purposes.

details.description: A human-readable description of the action.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a task within a project.

projectId.description: Reference to the Project this task belongs to.

projectName.description: Denormalized name of the project for easier display.

description.description: A detailed description of the task.

status.description: The current status of the task.

userId.description: Reference to the User who created this task.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the task was last updated.

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles. The document ID '{userId}' must match the Firebase Authentication UID for the user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

definition.description: Stores high-level projects in a root collection.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The unique identifier for the project.

definition.description: Stores individual designs in a root collection.

params.name: designId
params.description: The unique identifier for the design.

definition.description: Stores user invitations. Once an invite is used for signup, it should be deleted.

params.name: inviteId
params.description: The unique identifier for the invite.

definition.description: Stores a log of all significant user activities for auditing purposes.

params.name: auditLogId
params.description: The unique identifier for the audit log entry.

definition.description: Stores individual tasks in a root collection.

params.name: taskId
params.description: The unique identifier for the task.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure separates Users, Projects, Designs, and Invites into distinct root-level collections. This flat structure facilitates efficient, app-wide queries, allowing any authenticated user to view all projects and designs to foster collaboration. User-specific data is stored in `/users/{userId}`. Write access to projects and designs is controlled by a `userId` field within each document, ensuring that only the owner or an administrator can modify content. This design supports secure, independent authorization for write operations while enabling open read access for a collaborative workspace. Audit logs are stored in a separate root collection with admin-only read access.
